script: Hi, this is Marcus Delacroix calling at about eleven at night. It's my Great Dane, Bruno. He's been trying to throw up for an hour and nothing comes out, his belly looks swollen and hard, and he keeps pacing and whining. I'm really scared. Please call me right away on five five five, zero one four two.

Hello, it's Priya Anand. My cat Mochi has been limping on her back left leg since this afternoon. She's eating and purring fine, she just won't put much weight on it. If someone could ring me tomorrow morning on five five five, zero one eight eight, I'd like to get her seen soon.

Good evening, this is Tom Whitfield. I'd like to book Pepper, my beagle, in for her yearly vaccines sometime next month, and also ask about a refill of her flea tablets. No rush at all. My number is five five five, zero two seven one.

Hi, Lena Okafor here. About twenty minutes ago my puppy Biscuit got into a whole bar of dark chocolate, the wrapper's shredded. He's small, maybe eight pounds, and he's shaking a little. Please call me back as soon as you hear this, five five five, zero three six six.
